content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required authorization, not invalid coding or billing order, so resubmitting unchanged or correcting claim data would not address it. Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, but the denial permits a formal medical-necessity appeal. Appeal with the available clinical documentation before treating the payer path as exhausted or assigning any balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
